title: An Inexact Halpern-accelerated Preconditioned Generalized Proximal Point Algorithm for the Maximal Monotone Inclusion Problem
summary: This paper studies an inexact Halpern-accelerated generalized proximal point algorithm with an admissible positive semidefinite preconditioner $\mathcal{M}$ for solving maximal monotone inclusion problems. The proposed framework combines Halpern anchoring, resolvent inexactness, and relaxation over the full weight range $ρ\in(0,2]$, thereby covering both under-relaxed and over-relaxed proximal iterations within a unified scheme.
